castle_intro.speaker: Narrator
castle_intro.text: Rainbow sunset wrapped Sky's princess castle in warm, glowy colors.

castle_intro.speaker: Narrator
castle_intro.text: In the tower, the Rainbow Adventure Map had gone dim. Its shining paths were fading away.

castle_intro.speaker: Sky
castle_intro.text: Oh! My sparkly collar is glowing. Someone needs help.

castle_intro.speaker: Narrator
castle_intro.text: A gentle clue shimmered toward the tower door. The waterfall needed Sky first.

map_first_visit.speaker: Narrator
map_first_visit.text: The Rainbow Adventure Map twinkled softly. One path still had a sleepy glow.

map_first_visit.speaker: Sky
map_first_visit.text: That waterfall sparkle is calling me. I can help there.

map_first_visit.speaker: Narrator
map_first_visit.text: Click the glowing waterfall marker to travel to Glitterdrop Waterfall.

waterfall_intro.speaker: Bibi
waterfall_intro.text: Hi, Sky. The waterfall song is all mixed up today.

waterfall_intro.speaker: Bibi
waterfall_intro.text: My shiny drops, flowers, splash stones, and stream sparkles need a little help.

waterfall_intro.speaker: Sky
waterfall_intro.text: We can do it together. Let's make the rainbow mist sing again.

waterfall_complete.speaker: Bibi
waterfall_complete.text: You did it, Sky! The crystal is glowing and the waterfall is singing again.

waterfall_complete.speaker: Sky
waterfall_complete.text: Hooray! The map will shine a little brighter now.

map_after_waterfall.speaker: Narrator
map_after_waterfall.text: Back in the map room, the Glitterdrop Waterfall path shimmered with fresh color.

map_after_waterfall.speaker: Sky
map_after_waterfall.text: Bibi is smiling again, and I brought home my first Sunset Ribbon.

map_after_waterfall.speaker: Narrator
map_after_waterfall.text: A leafy forest path is waking up next.

forest_intro.speaker: Hazel
forest_intro.text: Hello, Sky. The echo lanterns are quiet in my forest today.

forest_intro.speaker: Hazel
forest_intro.text: Can you help me with colors, shapes, sorting, and a little letter glow?

forest_intro.speaker: Sky
forest_intro.text: Yes, Hazel. We'll wake the friendly echoes together.

forest_complete.speaker: Hazel
forest_complete.text: Listen, Sky. The forest is singing back now.

forest_complete.speaker: Sky
forest_complete.text: The map will love this new leafy sparkle.

map_after_forest.speaker: Narrator
map_after_forest.text: The forest path glowed bright and cozy across the Rainbow Adventure Map.

map_after_forest.speaker: Sky
map_after_forest.text: Hazel's echoes are happy again. I think the beach is waking up next.

beach_intro.speaker: Tilly
beach_intro.text: Hi, Sky. My bright tide chime forgot its splashy pattern.

beach_intro.speaker: Tilly
beach_intro.text: Can we count, sort, and match until the beach sparkles again?

beach_intro.speaker: Sky
beach_intro.text: Yes. We'll make the waves feel cheerful and sunny.

beach_complete.speaker: Tilly
beach_complete.text: The tide chime is ringing! The beach feels bright again.

beach_complete.speaker: Sky
beach_complete.text: I can almost hear the zoo calling from the map now.

map_after_beach.speaker: Narrator
map_after_beach.text: The beach path rolled across the map like a warm ribbon of seafoam.

map_after_beach.speaker: Sky
map_after_beach.text: Tilly is smiling. Next I can help at the zoo.

zoo_intro.speaker: Nora
zoo_intro.text: Welcome, Sky. Our happy sounds got mixed and muddled.

zoo_intro.speaker: Nora
zoo_intro.text: Let's listen, match, remember, count, and help the zoo hum again.

zoo_intro.speaker: Sky
zoo_intro.text: I'm ready. We'll help every happy sound find home.

zoo_complete.speaker: Nora
zoo_complete.text: You did it. The zoo sounds bright and joyful again.

zoo_complete.speaker: Sky
zoo_complete.text: That means one more surprise is waiting at the house.

map_after_zoo.speaker: Narrator
map_after_zoo.text: The zoo path twinkled into place on the map with cheerful color.

map_after_zoo.speaker: Sky
map_after_zoo.text: Only Mimi's house is still waiting now.

house_intro.speaker: Mimi
house_intro.text: Hi, Sky. My secret surprise room needs one more kind helper.

house_intro.speaker: Mimi
house_intro.text: Can you help me sort, match, and follow the cozy steps?

house_intro.speaker: Sky
house_intro.text: Of course. We'll make your surprise shine.

house_complete.speaker: Mimi
house_complete.text: The secret surprise is glowing! Thank you, Sky.

house_complete.speaker: Sky
house_complete.text: All the ribbons feel warm and ready for a big castle celebration soon.

map_after_house.speaker: Narrator
map_after_house.text: Back at the map room, every first path glowed with new sunset color.

map_after_house.speaker: Sky
map_after_house.text: My ribbons are ready. The Sunset Rainbow Celebration can come next.
